name: UGC 9405 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 9405, an isolated dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc9405-hubble
story: A small irregular galaxy living in isolation. Hubble resolved its stars to help map the distances and motions of galaxies in our cosmic neighborhood.

claims.text: UGC 9405 is one of twenty nearby isolated irregular dwarf galaxies
UGC09405 is a galaxy target of Hubble program 12546
The program uses resolved stars (tip of the red giant branch) to map the 3D distribution and velocity field of nearby galaxies
